ADLBC.PARAM.CR-5.reason: Define-XML ADLBC.PARAM states Concatenated LB.LBTEST, '(', LB.LBSTRESU and ')' with no separator, which the literal probe (adlbc-documented-rules.yaml lines 112-116) concatenates exactly, and every reported difference is the missing space before the parenthesis. ADLBC.BASE.CR-3.reason: Define-XML ADLBC.BASE gives Method: LB.LBSTNRHI as its single source, although the quote recorded here is blank. ADLBC.BASE.CR-3.title: Baseline-value method names the upper normal-range limit instead of baseline results

ADLBC.CHG.CR-5.reason: Define-XML ADLBC.CHG states AVAL - BASE with no baseline exception, and both the literal and CHG__UNROUNDED columns (adlbc-documented-rules.yaml lines 165-179) give 0 where the reference CHG is missing. ADLBC.ALBTRVAL.CR-5.reason: Define-XML ADLBC.ALBTRVAL states the maximum of LBSTRESN-(1.5*ULN) and (.5*LLN) - LBSTRESN, with ULN and LLN bound to A1HI and A1LO by the cited ADLBC.A1HI and ADLBC.A1LO methods. Both the rounded and unrounded columns (adlbc-documented-rules.yaml lines 334-360) differ because the reference holds the sign-reversed differences, so the conflict does not depend on the precision reading.
ADLBC.ALBTRVAL.CR-5.title: Analysis-threshold distance disagrees with the documented formula

ADLBC.ANRIND.CR-8.3.title: Range-indicator method has incompatible codes and unresolved source and threshold text
